_claim: Origin's hoverBg for a plain menu row. Resolved as ALREADY NATIVE — DropdownMenuItem's own base recipe carries focus:bg-accent, so no bidezine code changed and no colour was invented (CLAUDE.md item 26).
_expectation_source: tokens/light.tokens.json defines accent as oklch components [0.97, 0, 0]. The runner drives the light copy (no dark class on the document), so that is the applicable mode. The value is the token's, not a number read back out of the browser.
_why_hover_reaches_a_focus_rule: The recipe styles focus:, not hover:. Radix moves DOM focus to a menu item on pointer-over, so a real hover is what a user's hover triggers — measuring the rule as written would have needed a keyboard path that no user takes to reach this state.
_precondition: ?open=panel-actions. This subject renders inside a Radix portal that exists only while the menu is open, and the runner cannot perform a preparatory click. See sandbox/src/lib/preconditions.ts.
